features.text: LOW-PROFILE MOBILITY: Compact design for greater freedom of movement during recovery.
NATURAL GAIT SUPPORT: Rocker sole encourages smooth, balanced steps.
ADAPTIVE COMFORT: Breathable liner and adjustable uprights provide stability.
ROOMY HEEL DESIGN: Extra cushioning relieves pressure and supports Achilles recovery.
IDEAL USES: Perfect for forefoot injuries, ankle sprains, and stable fractures.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Forefoot injuries and stable foot fractures
